headline.zh: 让内容，成为可以探索的空间。
headline.en: Turn content into a place to explore.

description.zh: 这是一套可维护的三维展厅模板。你可以替换组织介绍、产品、照片、视频和新闻，也可以继续扩建房间。所有默认内容均为演示示例。
description.en: This configurable 3D showroom template connects spaces with products, stories and media. Replace the sample content or build additional rooms. All bundled content is demonstrative.

description.zh: 演示从研究、草图到模型的开发过程。
description.en: An illustrative path from research and sketches to models.

description.zh: 用分类、图片、模型与详情介绍产品。
description.en: Explore products through categories, images, models and details.

description.zh: 展示工序、检查、包装和交付的概念流程。
description.en: An illustrative sequence of production, inspection, packaging and delivery.

description.zh: 保持好奇，用内容连接每个空间。
description.en: Connect spaces through curiosity and content.

description.zh: 让不同环节的信息清晰可见。
